verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own docs show use across several operating systems: Windows login, Linux PAM and Android/NitroPhone. They also name example services such as Google, Facebook, Microsoft/Office 365, Nextcloud, Thunderbird and OpenVPN. These are scattered feature pages and examples, not a dedicated compatibility catalog, and nothing covers browser compatibility. Missing for 10: a published compatibility catalog of supported services, documented browser compatibility, macOS/iOS coverage, independent hands-on confirmation of cross-OS use.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works across my operating systems and browsers, with a published compatibility catalog of supported services
